# Puffin Ship

> Puffin Ship is a video content agency. We produce short form video for brands at a volume traditional agencies cannot match, using a production platform we built and run ourselves. Depending on what a brand needs, we hand over finished video, publish it to their channels on a schedule, or run the whole program and tune it against what performs.

## What we do

We make short form video for brands and we keep it coming. A brand tells us what they sell, who buys it, and what their content should sound like. We build the formats, the look, and the rules their videos follow, and then video ships steadily instead of in bursts.

Every video arrives finished and ready to post, made for the channels the brand cares about. Nothing goes out unchecked; every video passes a review step before it reaches the brand or its audience.

## Why we can produce at this volume

We built our own production platform and we run it ourselves. It is not a stack of subscriptions anyone can go and buy, and our output does not depend on how many editors we can hire. That is the reason we can promise a volume a traditional agency structurally cannot, and the reason the way our clients' content gets made is not available to their competitors.

A brand's rules are set once and applied to every video after that. No drift, no re-briefing, no explaining the brand again next month.

## Using the platform directly

Access to the platform and its API can be part of an engagement, if a brand's team would rather run some of it themselves. We set that access up as part of the engagement; there is no public sign-up and no self-serve plan.

## How we work with a brand

We build the program around what the brand needs. Some want finished video handed over and nothing else. Some want us publishing to their channels and tuning against what performs. Most land somewhere in between. We work out the shape of it with them, then we build it and keep it running.

## How an engagement runs

1. **We learn the brand**: what it sells, who buys it, and what its content should sound like. We do the work here so nobody is briefing us every month.
2. **We build the content system**: the formats, the look, and the rules the videos follow. This is the part that makes everything after it repeatable.
3. **Video ships on a schedule**: content arrives steadily, either delivered to the brand or published straight to its channels.
4. **We iterate on what performs**: when we are running the full program we watch what lands and adjust, so the content gets better at its job over time.

## Who it's for

- **Brands and products**: companies that need a steady stream of content and don't have a team to make it. We become that team without them hiring one.
- **Services and local businesses**: businesses that live on attention in their area and can't produce enough of it to stay top of mind.
- **Founders and experts**: people with real knowledge and an audience worth building, who never find the time to turn one into the other.

## Pricing

Pricing depends on volume and how involved a brand wants us to be, so we quote each brand individually. There are no published rates and no self-serve tiers.

To get a quote, use the form at https://puffinship.com/#contact and tell us what you need. We reply by email, usually within a day.

## How we compare

- Different from a traditional agency: agencies scale by hiring people, so their volume is capped by headcount. Ours is not.
- Different from a freelancer or a single editor: output stays at the same pace in month six as it was in month one.
- Different from a social media management tool: those manage distribution. We create the video supply, and publish it too if that is what the brand wants.
